matching_criterion_description: Hereditary spastic paraplegia spectrum presentation observed in SPG93 cohort.
100% (16/16) of SPG93 patients exhibit cerebral white matter neuroimaging abnormalities on brain MRI.
Presence of severe infantile pulmonary arterial hypertension rules out chronic SPG93 and points to MMDS1.
Presence of catastrophic systemic lactic acidosis argues against SPG93.
